Use one row per session or module. For a one-day workshop, use clock times; for a semester course, use week/date.

| Session | Topic | Format | Preparation | Estimated time |

## Delivery notes

- Keep lecture blocks short enough to alternate explanation with practice.
- Add breaks explicitly for intensive workshops.
- Link pre-class readings or exercises in the Preparation column.
- Update this page whenever modules are reordered.
